text:
drew: Seeing weird eviction spikes in ap-southeast1. Provisioner is revoking 'tiles' in a staggered pattern and pods in the same rack are getting sequentially evicted.

maria: hmm. any correlation with the new lease timeout rollout?

drew: yes lines up with yesterday's deploy. lease-grace was reduced from 60s -> 10s. saw chunked revocations every ~30s across nodes.

sam: that short? omg. that's likely the cause. the reconciler is hitting backoff and revoking dependent leases in waves.

infra-bot: deploy/redwood-provisioner v2.14 rolled by @maria at 2025-11-02T07:12Z

maria: rolled to 3/4 of apac pools only. we planned canary but reconciliation flag misfired.

ops-oncall: impact: increased pod evictions, ~3% higher scheduling latency, gpu busy fraction unchanged.

drew: dumps: small excerpt —
```
I1102 07:33:12 lease_revoke.go:87 revoking tile=tile-az1-007 reason=heartbeat-missed ttl=10s
I1102 07:33:42 lease_revoke.go:91 revoke-complete tile=tile-az1-007 beneficiaries=5
I1102 07:33:42 scheduler.go:542 preempt triggered pod=trainer-xx evict node=nodexx-07
```

maria: can we flip the grace to 45s for the rest of apac while we investigate?

sam: yes, create a quick patch to override config in the apac feature-gate. i'll hold off on promoting the canary.

ops-oncall: temp mitigation: set provisioner.leaseGrace=45s in ap-southeast1 configmap. rolling restart to pick it up?

drew: rolling restart of provisioner pod fixed the staggered revocations almost immediately. evictions dropped.

maria: root cause: a race between the fast lease expiry + reconciler backoff that batches revoke calls per tile shard. combined with our rack-level HA placement we unintentionally concentrated victims.

sam: followups: 1) revert global rollout until we add smoothing, 2) add a random jitter to revoke timing, 3) telemetry: expose revokeBatchSize metric.

ops-oncall: filed infra-7201 with the logs and suggested mitigations. tagging release and scheduler teams.

drew: noted one cost angle — when this happened, we saw small-ish re-placements that briefly increased spot instance churn and bumping cloud egress by ~0.2% for the hour. not huge but noticeable.

maria: good call. include cost delta in postmortem.

sam: i'll add a canary gate requiring revokeBatchSize < 10 and leaseGrace >= 30s.

infra-bot: alert cleared: ap-southeast1 eviction-spike — duration 14m

ops-oncall: continuing to watch, but looks stable. thanks team :thumbsup:
